main.description: DRAFT in the temp namespace; may change without notice. Optional public commitment to the crossing-completion of a completed private substrate crossing, published in the emitter's own repository. A remote proof under the ATProtocol Attestation Specification v1.0 with this profile's repository rule: `cid` is the CIDv1 of the committed record with `signatures` removed and `$sig` inserted, where `$sig` is this commitment record minus `cid`, plus `repository` set to the committed record's `emittedBy`. The committed record is housed in no repository, so a verifier must be given `emittedBy` as the repository DID. This CID differs from the emitter inline-signature CID. Discloses existence, emitter and time only. Never published for a crossing that did not complete, for a crossing-intent, or for a blocked gate check.

cid.description: Remote-proof CID of the committed record.

emittedBy.description: Emitting party of the committed record; must equal the housing repository's DID.

previous.description: Optional link to the emitter's previous commitment.
